title: 3D spatial visualization
observableEvidence: Reasons about cubes and rectangular solids (e.g., counting faces/edges/vertices, visualizing a cut, fold, or rotation, or counting unit cubes in a stack) and explains the spatial reasoning used.
masteryCheckRule: Deterministic check that the learner reaches the exact count or measurement asked for and can describe the 3D structure in words, plus one independent delayed check.
